title.zh: 修订第 1613 号共和国法特定项目的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Sixteen Hundred Thirteen
title.orig: An Act to Amend Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Sixteen Hundred Thirteen

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 8 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_2016_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Item B-004.36, title B, appendix A of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred thirteen, is amended to read as follows:
"B-004.36: Mindoro-Tomas Claudio and Echabelita Streets, Paco, Manila :GR : 15.00 : 3 : 15.00 : : : : : : 4 : : asphalt paving."

Item B-004.44, title B, appendix A of the same Act, is amended to read as follows:
"B-004.44: Construction of waiting shed in corner Herran and Calderon Streets :GR :10 :10 :10: :::::::: Improvement.
"B-004.44-a: Asphalt paving of Liwayway Street, Sta. Ana :GR :8 :8 :8: ::::::::."

Item B-004.40, title B, appendix A of the same Act, is amended to read as follows:
"B-004.40: Asphalt paving of Kansas Street (from Vermont to San Andres :GR :12:12.00:12.00: : : : :8.00: : : : Improvement."

Item 21, subsection g, section two of the same Act, is amended by adding a new item thereof for the City of Manila:
"21-a. Construction of Rizal's Monument at the corner of Penafrancia and Zamora Street ₱10,000.00.
"21-b. Improvement of Sases Puericulture Center ₱11,000.00.
"21-c. Construction of public plaza at Fabie Estate, Paco ₱8,000.00."

Item 25, subsection g, section two of the same Act for the City of Manila is amended to read as follows:
"25. Asphalting and construction of curb and gutter of Vermont Street, from Singalong Street to San Marcelino Street, Malate ₱5,000.00."

Item 28, subsection g, section two of the same Act, is amended by adding a new item thereof for the City of Manila:
"28. Asphalting and construction of curb and gutter of Taal Street, from San Andres Street, to Esguerra Street, Sta. Ana ₱10,000.00."
;"28-a Asphalt paving for Cortada Street from San Luis to A. Flores, Ermita ₱5,000.00."
Item (f), for the City of Manila, group IV, subparagraph 28, subsection f, section two, and item 22, for the City of Manila, subsection g, section two of the same Act, are hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 22, 1957.
